name: Alex Padilla

issue_poll.name: USC Schwarzenegger Institute / USC Price California Issues Poll, Oct 30–Nov 2, 2022
issue_poll.note: Open-ended most important issue question, registered voters. Five issues tied at 3% for ranks 8–12; took Immigration, Taxes, Abortion in the poll's listed order, dropping Democracy and Gas prices.
